purpose: Define logical locks as explicit coordination identities over exact protected resource/scope, separate from resource identity and process/thread identity.

topics.name: Lock Identity
topics.purpose: Define logical locks as explicit coordination identities over exact protected resource/scope, separate from resource identity and process/thread identity.

semantics.identity_rule: Each lock definition/instance has an explicit identity.
semantics.process_rule: PID/thread/file handle are runtime bindings/evidence, not canonical lock identity.
semantics.authority_rule: Holding a coordination lock does not itself grant domain authorization.
semantics.expiry_rule: Lease-style expiry semantics are explicit where used.

invariants.rule: Definitions, requests, validation evidence, authorization decisions and concrete executions remain separate identities; only an explicit validated and authorized dispatcher path may create effects.

hard_gates.condition: PID used as canonical lock identity
